turn.user_message: Explain the first three steps on the round
turn.context: Playbook §5, the second 'tell me more': the three steps on the evening round, and how the draft is put together.

text: The summary was already filling in. Here are the three steps on the evening round, and who says yes at each.
Tojo gathers, checks and drafts. People make every decision.
chat.pointer: Press Next step to walk through it. The loop shows what Tojo is doing at each step.
prompts: How would you record each decision?
What if the doctor changes their mind?
Does it work for insured patients?

blocks.title: Three steps, then a yes
blocks.deck: What Tojo does between the doctor’s word and the signed early summary.

blocks.caption: Tojo’s loop: it notices, gathers, checks, drafts, then asks a person.

steps.title: Hear the decision
steps.does: The doctor taps once on the ward phone to say the patient can likely go tomorrow. Tojo takes that as its signal.
checks: It is the patient’s own doctor
The patient is not waiting on a test

hand.does: Taps once to say the patient can likely go

steps.title: Put the draft together
steps.does: Tojo gathers the facts recorded since admission. It writes the draft summary, the expected bill and the list of medicines to take home.
checks: No medicine changed after the last note
The bill matches what was used

steps.title: Ask for the yes
steps.does: The draft appears on the doctor’s phone. Anything missing or unclear is marked for the doctor to look at.
checks: Late reports are named, never guessed

hand.does: Reads the early summary, then signs or corrects it
